name: io.github.scoutwyze-max/compute-mcp
title: ScoutWyze Compute
description: Ranks current RunPod GPU offers by price and freshness. Supports x402/USDC-on-Base payments.

environmentVariables.name: SCOUTWYZE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid Bearer API key from POST /v1/signup + POST /v1/checkout-sessions. Optional — omit to run unauthenticated, in which case scoutwyze_rank returns a real x402 payment challenge instead of ranked results.

environmentVariables.name: SCOUTWYZE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the default API base URL (https://scoutwyze-compute.fly.dev) — for local development only.
